nodes.label: Real Estate Listings
nodes.rationale: Team-scoped listing records covering channel content, pricing, availability, publication rules, portal feeds and reconciliation. Domain package stays presentation-agnostic; UI and API live in companion -filament/-livewire/-api packages.

nodes.label: Composer Unprefixed / GitHub module- Prefix
nodes.rationale: Packagist names drop the `module-` prefix the GitHub repositories carry (liberusoftware/module-real-estate-listings on GitHub is liberusoftware/real-estate-listings on Packagist). READMEs restate it per package because the mismatch is otherwise read as a mistake.
